description: Defines a Kotlin interface 'NotebooksRecyclerListener' with callback methods for item click and long click events within a recycler view context.

classes.name: NotebooksRecyclerListener
classes.description: An interface for handling click events on notebook items within a recycler view.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Callback invoked when an item is clicked, passing the item's position.

methods.name: onLongClick
methods.description: Callback invoked on a long click, passing the item's position and returning a boolean indicating action handled.
